Inogen (INGN) Market Valuation Rose While Timpani Capital Management Has Increased Stake; Jaffetilchin Investment Partners Raised Apple (AAPL) Position
June 13, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Jaffetilchin Investment Partners Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 8.93% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jaffetilchin Investment Partners Llc bought 3,458 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 42,180 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.08M, up from 38,722 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jaffetilchin Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $937.32 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.82% or $1.58 during the last trading session, reaching $190.7. About 18.00M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
